characterWorkflow: One dedicated agent per character, sequential character work with independent root approval before the next character.

ui.scope: Bounded visual, native keyboard and mouse confirmation; resized Chromium, not physical-touch or full WCAG testing.

artifact.dimensionsAndAlpha: Unchanged for used images; unused optional images require current exhaustive draw proof and guarded full-size transparent placeholders. Original game assets untouched.

knownLimitations: Some legacy seated reactions retain documented canonical fallback poses; not all52 rivals have newly painted seated art.

Per-character dossiers state the actual sampled visual and geometry scope; roster mechanics checks do not claim every possible anatomical hand placement was individually viewed.
The production build retains its existing >500kB bundle warning.
